how_to_apply: Read the General Information & Instructions and the application form on the University website, www.dbrau.ac.in.
Fill in the online application form on the University Samarth Portal, dbraurec.samarth.edu.in, on or before 15-10-2026.
Deposit the application fee (Rs. 1,000) as per the instructions given in the application.
Take a printout of the online application form.

Send the printout with self-attested photocopies of all academic and other required documents supporting your claims (eligibility, achievements, publications, etc.) by Registered/Speed Post only, so that it reaches the Registrar (Residential Wing), Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Agra (U.P.) - 282004, by 20-10-2026, 5:00 PM.
Use an A-4 size envelope carrying an address slip with the Advertisement No., Post Name and Application ID.
If applying for more than one post, deposit the fee for each post and send each application form and its documents in a separate envelope.
The University may withdraw any advertised post at any time without assigning any reason, may choose not to fill any post, and may increase or decrease the number of posts.
No separate correspondence will be entertained.
Candidates should visit the University website periodically for updates.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last apply date for DBRAU Agra Guest Faculty 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 15-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the Eligibility to apply for DBRAU Agra Guest Faculty 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be eligible as per UGC/AICTE guidelines for Guest Faculty positions. Subject-wise qualification details are not given in the advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are being recruited by DBRAU Agra Guest Faculty 2026?
faq.answer: Total 88 vacancies (computed from the subject-wise list).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for DBRAU Agra Guest Faculty 2026?
faq.answer: Under the Self-Finance Scheme, Assistant Professors on period basis are paid Rs. 600 per period, up to a maximum of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for DBRAU Agra Guest Faculty 2026?
faq.answer: The prescribed fee is Rs. 1,000 per application. It is non-refundable, and a separate fee is required for each post applied for.

faq.question: Q6. How to apply for DBRAU Agra Guest Faculty 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online on the Samarth portal (dbraurec.samarth.edu.in) and send the printout with self-attested documents to the Registrar (Residential Wing) by Registered/Speed Post.
